name: European Commission and National Market-Surveillance Authorities
description: European Commission and National Market-Surveillance Authorities set and enforce product sustainability, safety and market-access requirements. The immediate issue is ESPR readiness, Digital Product Passports, product safety and imported-goods controls. Its decisions or actions can block products, require information or order corrective action.
urgency_rationale: New product-information and sustainability duties affect design systems now.
intel_dossier: 🔎 Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation: ESPR introduces sustainability requirements and Digital Product Passports. | https://commission.europa.eu/energy-climate-change-environment/standards-tools-and-labels/products-labelling-rules-and-requirements/sustainable-products/ecodesign-sustainable-products-regulation_en

engagement_tactics.label: Create a single evidence room and joint workplan with European Commission and National Market-Surveillance Authorities
engagement_tactics.rationale: Gives the authority traceable data, named owners and early visibility of corrective action.

engagement_tactics.rationale: Collective advocacy cannot substitute for company-specific compliance evidence.

engagement_tactics.label: Wait for a notice, inspection or deficiency letter
engagement_tactics.rationale: Reactive engagement reduces room to correct problems before enforcement.

name: Semiconductor, Battery, Mineral and Contract-Manufacturing Suppliers
description: Semiconductor, Battery, Mineral and Contract-Manufacturing Suppliers determine resilience, human-rights exposure, carbon data and product compliance. The immediate issue is critical chips, mineral provenance, battery data, RoHS and DPP information. Its decisions or actions can stop production or prevent compliant product passports.
urgency_rationale: Supply-chain data is becoming part of market access, not optional reporting.
intel_dossier: 🔎 European Chips Act: The Chips Act seeks to strengthen Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem and resilience. | https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/european-chips-act
🔎 RoHS Directive: RoHS restricts hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment. | https://environment.ec.europa.eu/topics/waste-and-recycling/rohs-directive_en

engagement_tactics.label: Segment critical suppliers and fund traceability plus remediation with Semiconductor, Battery, Mineral and Contract-Manufacturing Suppliers
engagement_tactics.rationale: Protects continuity while addressing root causes rather than shifting them down-tier.

engagement_tactics.label: Terminate every non-conforming supplier immediately
engagement_tactics.rationale: Abrupt exits can deepen shortages and hide problems in less visible tiers.

engagement_tactics.label: Accept annual self-certification as sufficient
engagement_tactics.rationale: High-risk supply chains require evidence, audit and corrective-action closure.

description: Retailers, Telecom Operators and Online Marketplaces control distribution, returns, product information and customer access. The immediate issue is safety evidence, repair, labelling, recalls and platform compliance. Its decisions or actions can delist products or impose costly service requirements.
urgency_rationale: Retailer action can remove products faster than formal enforcement.

engagement_tactics.label: Build a joint service, quality and continuity plan with Retailers, Telecom Operators and Online Marketplaces
engagement_tactics.rationale: Makes performance expectations explicit and creates early-warning triggers.

engagement_tactics.label: Promise priority supply to every major account
engagement_tactics.rationale: Conflicting commitments become impossible to honour during a disruption.

engagement_tactics.label: Limit contact to sales teams
engagement_tactics.rationale: Commercial dialogue alone misses quality, safety and operational dependencies.

name: Factory Employees, Engineers and European Works Councils
description: Factory Employees, Engineers and European Works Councils hold manufacturing and design knowledge and formal consultation rights. The immediate issue is automation, skills, restructuring, chemical exposure and workload. Its decisions or actions can delay transformation or create knowledge and labour risk.
urgency_rationale: Semiconductor and electronics skills are scarce, while restructuring has formal timelines.
intel_dossier: 🔎 European Chips Act: The Chips Act seeks to strengthen Europe’s semiconductor ecosystem and resilience. | https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/european-chips-act
🔎 RoHS Directive: RoHS restricts hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment. | https://environment.ec.europa.eu/topics/waste-and-recycling/rohs-directive_en
🔎 EU cybersecurity policy: ENISA supports EU cybersecurity policy, certification and operational cooperation. | https://www.enisa.europa.eu/
alternate_rationale: Manage Closely applies during plant change, closure, ramp-up or collective consultation.

engagement_tactics.label: Negotiate a safety, skills and workload plan with Factory Employees, Engineers and European Works Councils
engagement_tactics.rationale: Uses formal worker voice and measurable actions to reduce operational and labour risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Use attendance bonuses to suppress grievances
engagement_tactics.rationale: Treats symptoms, discourages reporting and can worsen fatigue-related risk.

engagement_tactics.label: Communicate only through line supervisors
engagement_tactics.rationale: Workers need trusted escalation channels and protection from retaliation.
